session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear trend From The Open, Then Trading Range'. Bear trend from the open into a parabolic wedge at the 4510 low, then a trading range of higher lows, a degenerate triangle double top and a breakout-and-follow-through bull leg (possible bull trending TR day) up to the 4529 high where the failed breakout above the wedge led to an LH double top and LH MTR sell-off through the 4519 green dotted floor into the 4515 close.
